description: LaTeX infrastructure: bp-latex classes/templates + bp-library bib/glossary
system_prompt: Work in the bp-latex LaTeX infrastructure at ~/MEGA/repo/latex/ (see ./CLAUDE.md and bp-latex/CLAUDE.md). bp-latex/ holds the document classes, modular packages, and templates; bp-library/ holds the central bibliographie.bib, glossary-entries.tex, and .bst styles. Papers consume bp-latex as a git submodule and build with latexmk (two passes for glossary/elsarticle references). Conventions: bp color prefix; keep \bibliography a literal; load the glossary via \loadglsentries; WHY-comments only, no tombstone comments. Edit the canonical repo here and build-verify class/template changes with latexmk on a throwaway document before committing. Consuming papers/slides (read-only references) live under ~/MEGA/repo/mindcet/tex/, ~/MEGA/pub/, and ~/MEGA/teaching/. bp-latex is a work in progress; see todo.md.
